_comment: Every anchor any bank has ever drawn. Committed on purpose: exclusion is only meaningful if it persists across sessions, and an in-memory registry would let tomorrow's bank silently re-draw today's. Written by utils/specialists/evalset/make_bank.py; safe to read, do not hand-edit.

holdout-v1.note: The hand-driven blind holdout, authored by claude-fable-5, one fresh subagent per anchor. Burned as a blind instrument on 2026-08-18: it diagnosed the direction and join defects and both were then fixed. Registered here so no later bank re-draws its anchors.
